integrity: The proof reduces one BFGS update to its two-dimensional active secant plane, applies a sharp spectral second-moment inequality, optimizes the resulting trace-determinant condition ratio analytically, and gives an attained endpoint-eigenspace construction. Historical conditioning and scaling literature is explicitly separated from the new one-update comparison claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies one exact-arithmetic direct BFGS Hessian update from B_0=I after normalizing lambda_min(H)=1. It does not classify arbitrary initial scaling, multiple BFGS updates, finite precision, nonquadratic curvature pairs, or Hessian classes with additional structural restrictions.
title: Sharp one-update conditioning law for BFGS on two-curvature quadratics
